text_zh: 第3排的别碰，上个人用完就没回来过
text_en: Don't touch row 3, last guy never came back

text_zh: 铅币记得数两遍，有时会自己少掉几个
text_en: Count coins twice, they disappear sometimes

text_zh: 熔蜡的那些便宜但烫手，literal的烫
text_en: Wax stuff is cheap but literally burns

text_zh: 谁又把我的笔拿走了？！第三次了！
text_en: WHO took my pen AGAIN?! Third time!

text_zh: 价格又涨了...上周还是15铅币来着
text_en: Prices up again... was 15 coins last week

text_zh: 这破地方连个椅子都没有，腿都站麻了
text_en: No chairs in this place, legs going numb

text_zh: D-0891说左边柜子里的都是好货
text_en: D-0891 says left cabinet has the good stuff

text_zh: D-1047留：蓝色的那个救过我命
text_en: From D-1047: blue one saved my life

text_zh: 今天店主又换人了？这是第几个了
text_en: New shopkeeper again? How many is that now

text_zh: 有人在货架后面写字，但我看不懂
text_en: Someone writing behind shelves, can't read it
